diagnosis: AccountProfileUpdateSerializer handles user profile edits with an optional nested membership block. When updating membership, the serializer extracts organization_id directly from the payload and creates or updates a TenantMembership record linking the authenticated user to that organization without checking whether the user was invited or permitted to join it. Any authenticated user can bind themselves to high-privilege corporate organizations.
